# Baila Dembow

> Baila Dembow is the leading Latin event brand in the Netherlands: reggaeton, dembow, salsa and bachata parties in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Groningen, Leiden, Eindhoven and beyond, running since 2023 with 25,000+ fans. Organised by House Decoded Events, Amsterdam (KVK 67994725).

## Halloween in Amsterdam: The Latin Halloween Festival (31 October 2026)

- Name: The Latin Halloween Festival by Baila Dembow
- Date and time: Saturday 31 October 2026, 23:00 to 05:00
- Venue: IJLAND, TT Vasumweg 171, Amsterdam (Amsterdam-Noord)
- What it is: Amsterdam's biggest Latin Halloween party. Four years running, 1500+ capacity, sold out every time. The venue becomes a haunted club with two areas.
- Music: reggaeton, dembow, dancehall, salsa, bachata, merengue
- Extras: cash prize for best costume, free trick-and-treat sweets, spooky photobooth, food trucks on site
- Dress code: Scary, Sexy or Scary-Sexy. Costumes encouraged.
- Age: 18+, valid ID mandatory, no ID no entry
- Tickets: https://weeztix.shop/nxaqrkdz (early-bird tickets start from around EUR 10 and rise in tiers as the date gets closer)
- Refunds: non-refundable unless the event is cancelled or postponed; tickets may be resold via TicketSwap or exchanged privately
- Official page: https://bailadembow.com/halloween

## Door policy and house rules (summary)

- No hats unless the venue says otherwise; no tracksuits or trainers; no bags for men on the dancefloor
- Minimum age 18 unless stated otherwise for a specific event; ID is mandatory
- Respect everyone; no intolerance, sexism, violence or racism; no outside food or drinks; no weapons or hard drugs
- Photos and video are allowed; entering an event means the organiser may use footage for marketing
